subject: Re: Kickoff: GIFT - drift-resistant models for platform customers
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing confirmed: Katya 70%, Amara 60%, Saoirse 40%. Workable for the 6/17 review.

Compute: the iterative self-training loops are the cost center - every adaptation run is effectively N retrains, and the interpolation-step sweep (how far we push virtual samples toward target per iteration) multiplies that. I am estimating ~40 A100s sustained on titan-a100 through May, spiking for the benchmark repro.

Budget: Idris has verbally earmarked $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-75 for this project; the adaptation sweeps below are costed against that line. Idris - cc'd, would be good to get that confirmed in writing before Q3 OKRs lock on 6/26.

Dependency: the pilot needs a stable snapshot of the customer corpus before the Corpus v2 freeze on 7/10, so Amara will cut it in June.

Ivo
